extraction_notes: Only SI Figure S20 reports extractable NH3 synthesis rates with labelled axes. SI Table S5 was used for Ru loadings on BaCeO3−xNyHz and BaCeO3. SI Figure S22 contains log-transformed kinetic plots (log C vs partial pressures) without directly reported rate units/values suitable for the rate field, so those points were not extracted. SI Figures S23–S25 show mass spectra or intensity ratios/signals, not NH3 outlet concentration, rate, or TOF, so they were not extracted. Characterisation, DFT, decomposition/TPD, and literature-comparison information was excluded.
